about: The Sentinel's own sounds (the anti-air missile tower). missile = one launch from its pods (every 1.0 s, heard where the tower stands), sentineltrack = its head swinging onto a new flyer and locking on (a servo and a tone, when it opens fire after a quiet spell). Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>).

entries.prompt: surface-to-air missile launches from a tower pod: sharp ignition bang, a fast rising rocket roar that whooshes up and away, close up
small anti-aircraft missile fired from a launcher, quick pop of the ejection charge then a hissing rocket motor screaming off into the sky
two homing missiles leave their launch tubes a split second apart, punchy whoosh-whoosh of rocket motors streaking upward, smoky hiss
short electric servo whir of a missile turret swinging around, ending with two quick electronic lock-on beeps
missile launcher head slews on its motor with a whining servo, a mechanical clunk and a rising electronic targeting tone
